items.title: Will Apollo's $40 billion for SpaceX to rent GPUs pay off?
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa and In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen discuss Apollo (APO) is lining up $40 billion in financing so SpaceX (SPCX) can rent GPUs as a neo cloud, funding CEO Elon Musk's wider ambitions.

Disclosure: Yahoo is a portfolio company of funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Global Management.

items.title: Apollo Is Focused on Investment Grade, De Giorgi Says
items.summary: Diego De Giorgi, partner and head of EMEA at Apollo Global Management, says the firm is focused on the global industrial renaissance and is particularly focused on investment-grade and the short end of curve. Speaking to Anna Edwards at Bloomberg's Global Credit Forum in London, he also says he expects a higher rate environment in 2027 alongside what he describes as the largest capex cycle in history.

items.title: Apollo Global Management (APO) Sees AI Needing $8 Trillion Of Capital
items.summary: Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) CEO Marc Rowan warned that the AI buildout could require about US$8 trillion of capital. Rowan argued that this AI funding need may push more borrowing into private credit and away from traditional U.S. bond markets. He flagged that financing large scale AI infrastructure could influence borrowing costs and funding access for companies outside the tech sector.
